newsitem.title: POLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Profit-taking seen on E.Europe mkts.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Profit-taking seen on E.Europe mkts.

text.p: After the bull run early in the year several East European blue-chips are ripe for profit-taking and investors should target new issues and lower priced solid stocks, Investmentbank Austria said in a report.

It said in its April East European report that weak earnings, high prices of some Polish and Hungarian blue-chips making them dearer than similar Western firms, and a flood of primary issues justified a correction of 5-10 percent.

"We recommend profit-taking in overshooting Polish and Hungarian stocks and remaining cautious about Czech equities, where weak earnings data proved the ongoing slow pace of corporate restructuring," IB Austria said in the report.
"We see opportunities in lower rated blue chips and new issues," the report dated March 21 added.
IB Austria Central European analysts said they continued to favour ComputerLand, Richter, Exbud and Borsod Chem but would seek lower price levels to buy those stocks.
